thread:
alex: Heads-up — small runtime version bump from 1.11.4 -> 1.11.5. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5129. Mostly changelog + version.py. Planning to merge before cutoff at 15:00 PT. Requesting late-merge exception if we need the extra few minutes. cc @maya @jen

release-bot: Reminder: release code freeze in 1h 15m. To request a late merge exception run `/release-exception` and include risk + rollback plan.

maya: Quick q — is this strictly docs/changelog? or are there behavior changes?

alex: It's primarily changelog + a one-line test tweak to avoid flakiness (no model-facing changes). Diff: `version.py: __version__ = "1.11.5"` and a changelog entry.

jen: Please add a short migration note in the changelog about the test tweak and the reason. Also tag who validated the test.

priya: FYI CI was flaky on that test yesterday but looked stable after last rerun. Can you squash the test fix into the bump commit so we don't get a transient revert?

alex: will squash, rerun, and post the CI link. rollback plan: revert PR and cut hotpatch branch release/1.11.5-hotfix if anything unexpected.

dan: pinging @eng-runtime reviewers — can someone do a quick LGTM if CI green? I'm short today.

maya: If CI passes and release-manager approves, I'm fine granting exception. Please run `make release` locally and paste the output in thread for a quick sanity check.

alex: local run snippet:```
$ git checkout -b release-bump-1.11.5
$ python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
$ make release
... tagging v1.11.5
```
CI rerun: https://ci.company.com/builds/234567 (green)

release-bot: Exception request submitted by alex at 1854123600, status: pending, assignee: maya.

maya: Assigned. I'll review the PR and infra implications (docker tags, helm values). If it's just changelog + test tweak and infra change is not required, I'll approve. Give me 20m.

dan: quick note — if we merge, remember to update infra helm values for runtime-image:redwood:v1.11.5 in infra repo (see note: infra PR required if not automated).

alex: understood. If approved, I'll open infra PR #987 with the helm value update. If we can't get everything in time, I'll hold the merge.

maya: Sounds good. If infra PR isn't ready in 30m from now we will block merge to avoid partial deploys.

priya: :thumbsup: thanks for moving quickly on the squash and CI.

alex: thanks — will post final when infra PR created or if we need to abort.

maya: Reviewed and thumbs up — exception granted contingent on infra PR opened within 20m.

alex: infra PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987. Merging the runtime bump now. I'll monitor post-deploy and revert if any issue.

release-bot: Code freeze time reached. Merged PR 5129 by alex as exception. Monitor: release-health channel for any regressions.

alex: Monitoring. If anything weird, I'll open hotpatch branch and revert main. Thanks all :rocket:
